6.4 Required Assurances

原本 PDF p.55

6.4 必要な保証

Secure key establishment depends upon the use of valid key-establishment keys. The security of key-establishment schemes also depends on limiting knowledge of the private keys to those who have been authorized to use them (i.e., their respective owners) and to the trusted third party that may have generated them.22 In addition to preventing unauthorized entities from gaining access to private keys, it is also important that owners have possession of the correct private keys. To explain the assurance requirements, some terminology needs to be defined. The owner of a key pair is the entity that is authorized to use the private key that corresponds to the owner’s public key, whether or not the owner generated the key pair. The recipient of a public key is the entity that is participating in a key-establishment transaction with the owner and obtains the owner’s public key before or during the current transaction. Prior to or during a key-establishment transaction, the participants in the transaction (i.e., parties U and V) shall obtain the appropriate assurances about the key pairs used during that transaction. The types of assurance that may be sought by one or both of the parties (U and/or V) concerning the components of a key pair (i.e., the private key and public key) are discussed in Sections 6.4.1 and 6.4.2.

原本 PDF p.55

安全な鍵確立は、有効な鍵確立鍵の使用に依存する。鍵確立スキームの安全性は、秘密鍵の知識を使用権限のある者（すなわち各所有者）と、鍵を生成した可能性のある信頼できる第三者に限定することにも依存する。²²不正な主体が秘密鍵にアクセスすることを防ぐだけでなく、所有者が正しい秘密鍵を所持することも重要である。保証要件を説明するため、いくつかの用語を定義する。鍵ペア所有者は、鍵ペアを自ら生成したかどうかにかかわらず、自身の公開鍵に対応する秘密鍵を使う権限のある主体である。公開鍵受領者とは、所有者との鍵確立トランザクションに参加し、現在のトランザクションの前または実行中に所有者の公開鍵を取得する主体である。トランザクションの参加者（当事者UおよびV）は、トランザクション前または実行中に、そのトランザクションで用いる鍵ペアについて適切な保証を取得しなければならない。鍵ペア要素（秘密鍵および公開鍵）に関し、一方または両方の当事者（Uおよび／またはV）が求める保証の種類を第6.4.1節および第6.4.2節で説明する。

未レビュー訳

6.4.1 Assurances Required by the Key-Pair Owner

原本 PDF p.55

6.4.1 鍵ペア所有者に必要な保証

Prior to the use of a key pair in a key-establishment transaction, the key-pair owner shall have assurance of the validity of the key pair. Assurance of key-pair validity provides assurance that a key pair was generated in accordance with the requirements in Sections 6.2 and 6.3. Key-pair validity implies public-key validity and assurance of possession of the correct private key. Assurance of key-pair validity can only be provided by an entity that has the private key (e.g., the owner). Depending on an organization’s requirements, a renewal of key-pair validity may be prudent. The method of obtaining initial and renewed assurance of key-pair validity is addressed in Section 6.4.1.1. Assurance of key-pair validity can be renewed at any time (see Section 6.4.1.1). As time passes, an owner may lose possession of the correct value of the private-key component of their key pair, e.g., due to an error; for this reason, renewed (i.e., current) assurance of possession of a private key can be of value for some applications. See Section 6.4.1.5 for techniques that the owner can use to obtain renewed assurance of private-key possession separately from assurance of key-pair validity.

原本 PDF p.55

鍵ペア所有者は、鍵確立トランザクションで鍵ペアを使用する前に、その鍵ペアの妥当性の保証を得なければならない。妥当性の保証は、第6.2節および第6.3節の要件に従って鍵ペアが生成されたことを保証する。鍵ペアの妥当性には、公開鍵の妥当性および正しい秘密鍵の所持の保証が含まれる。鍵ペア妥当性の保証を提供できるのは秘密鍵を持つ主体（例えば所有者）に限る。組織の要件によっては、鍵ペア妥当性の再確認が適切な場合がある。初回および更新後の保証を取得する方法は第6.4.1.1節で扱う。鍵ペア妥当性はいつでも更新できる（同節参照）。時間の経過やエラーなどにより、所有者が鍵ペアの秘密鍵要素の正しい値を保持できなくなる場合がある。このため、アプリケーションによっては秘密鍵所持について更新された（最新の）保証が有用である。鍵ペア妥当性の保証とは別に、秘密鍵所持の保証を更新する技法は第6.4.1.5節を参照。

未レビュー訳

An owner’s initial assurance of possession of his private key is obtained when assurance of key-pair validity is obtained (see Section 6.4.1.1); assurance of key-pair validity is required prior to the owner’s use of a key pair for key establishment. As time passes, an owner could lose possession of the private key of a key pair. For this reason, renewing the assurance of possession may be appropriate for some applications (i.e., assurance of possession can be refreshed). A discussion of the effect of time on the assurance of private-key possession is provided in SP 800-89. When renewed assurance that the owner continues to possess the correct associated private key is required, it shall be obtained in one or more of the following ways:

原本 PDF p.66

所有者は鍵ペア妥当性の保証を得る際に（第6.4.1.1節参照）、秘密鍵所持について初回の保証も得る。鍵確立に鍵ペアを使用する前にこの妥当性保証が必要である。時間の経過により所有者が鍵ペアの秘密鍵を所持しなくなる可能性がある。そのため、アプリケーションによっては所持保証を更新（再確認）するのが適切な場合がある。秘密鍵所持の保証に対する時間の影響はSP 800-89で説明する。所有者が正しい対応秘密鍵を引き続き所持する更新保証が必要な場合、次の1つ以上の方法で取得しなければならない。

3.The owner receives assurance via an encrypted certificate - The key-pair owner uses the private key while engaging in a key-establishment transaction with a Certificate Authority (trusted by the owner) using a scheme in this Recommendation after providing the CA with the corresponding public key. As part of this transaction, the CA generates a (new) certificate containing the owner’s public key and encrypts that certificate using (some portion of) the symmetric keying material that has been established. Only the encrypted form of the certificate is provided to the owner. By successfully decrypting the certificate and verifying the CA’s signature, the owner obtains assurance of possession of the correct private key (at the time of the key-establishment transaction).

6.4.2.2 Partial Public-Key Validation for RSA

原本 PDF p.68

6.4.2.2 RSA公開鍵の部分検証

Partial public-key validation for RSA consists of conducting plausibility tests. These tests determine whether the public modulus and public exponent are plausible, not necessarily whether they are completely valid, i.e., they may not conform to all RSA key-generation requirements as specified in this Recommendation. Plausibility tests can detect unintentional errors with a reasonable probability. Note that full RSA public-key validation is not specified in this Recommendation, as it is an area of ongoing research. Therefore, if an application requires assurance of full public-key validation, then another approved key-establishment method shall be used (e.g., as specified in SP 800-56A). Plausibility tests shall include the tests specified in Section 5.3.3 of SP 800-89, with the caveat that the bit length of the modulus shall be a length that is approved in this Recommendation.

原本 PDF p.68

RSA公開鍵の部分検証は、もっともらしさ試験の実施から成る。これらの試験は公開法と公開指数がもっともらしいかを判定するものであり、完全に有効であることを必ずしも判定しない。すなわち、本勧告のRSA鍵生成要件すべてに適合しない場合もある。もっともらしさ試験は、一定の確率で意図しない誤りを検出できる。本勧告では完全なRSA公開鍵検証を規定しない。これは現在も研究中の分野である。したがって、アプリケーションが完全な公開鍵検証の保証を必要とする場合、他の承認済み鍵確立方法（SP 800-56Aなど）を使用しなければならない。もっともらしさ試験には、法のビット長が本勧告で承認された長さであるという条件を付し、SP 800-89第5.3.3節に規定する試験を含めなければならない。

未レビュー訳

6.4.2.3 Recipient Assurances of an Owner’s Possession of a Private Key

原本 PDF p.68

6.4.2.3 公開鍵受領者が得る所有者の秘密鍵所持保証

When two parties engage in a key-establishment transaction, there is (at least) an implicit claim of ownership made whenever a public key is provided on behalf of a particular party. That party is considered to be a claimed owner of the corresponding key pair – as opposed to being a true owner – until adequate assurance can be provided that the party is actually the one authorized to use the private key. The claimed owner can provide such assurance by demonstrating its knowledge of that private key. The recipient of another party’s public key shall obtain an initial assurance that the other party (i.e., the claimed owner of the public key) actually possesses the associated private key, either prior to or concurrently with performing a key-establishment transaction with that other party. Obtaining this assurance is addressed in Sections 6.4.2.3.1 and 6.4.2.3.2. As time passes, renewing the assurance of possession may be appropriate for some applications; assurance of possession can be renewed as specified in Section 6.4.2.3.2. A discussion of the effect of time on the assurance of private-key possession is provided in SP 800-89. As part of the proper implementation of this Recommendation, system users and/or agents trusted to act on their behalf should determine which of the methods for obtaining assurance of possession meet their security requirements. The application tasked with performing key establishment on behalf of a party should determine whether or not to proceed with a key-establishment transaction, based upon the perceived adequacy of the method(s) used. Such knowledge may be explicitly provided to the application in some manner, or may be implicitly provided by the operation of the application itself. If a binding authority is the public-key recipient: At the time of binding an owner’s identifier to his public key, the binding authority (i.e., a trusted third party, such as a CA) shall obtain assurance that the owner is in possession of the correct private key. This assurance shall either be obtained using one of the methods specified in Section 6.4.2.3.2 (e.g., with the binding authority acting as the public-key recipient) or by using an approved alternative (see SP 800-57, Part 1, Sections 5.2 and 8.1.5.1.1.2). Recipients not acting in the role of a binding authority: The recipients shall obtain this assurance either through a trusted third party (see Section 6.4.2.3.1) or directly from the owner (i.e., the other party) (see Section 6.4.2.3.2) before using the derived keying material for purposes beyond those required during the key-establishment transaction itself. If the recipient chooses to obtain this assurance directly from the other party (i.e., the claimed owner of that public key), then to comply with this Recommendation, the recipient shall use one of the methods specified in Section 6.4.2.3.2. Note that the requirement that assurance of possession be obtained before using the established keying material for purposes beyond those of the key-establishment transaction itself does not prohibit the parties to a key-establishment transaction from using a portion of the derived or transported keying material during the key-establishment transaction for purposes required by that key-establishment scheme. For example, in a transaction involving a key-agreement scheme that incorporates key confirmation, the parties establish a (purported) shared secret, derive keying material, and − as part of that same transaction − use a portion of the derived keying material as the MAC key in their key-confirmation computations.

原本 PDF p.68

2者が鍵確立トランザクションを行うとき、特定の当事者に代わって公開鍵が提供される場合、少なくとも暗黙に所有権が主張される。その当事者が秘密鍵を使用する権限を実際に持つという十分な保証が得られるまでは、真の所有者ではなく当該鍵ペアの「主張された所有者」とみなす。主張された所有者は秘密鍵を知っていることを示して保証を提供できる。公開鍵受領者は、他方の当事者（公開鍵の主張された所有者）と鍵確立トランザクションを実施する前または同時に、相手が対応する秘密鍵を実際に所持する初回保証を得なければならない。取得方法は第6.4.2.3.1節および第6.4.2.3.2節に示す。アプリケーションによっては、所持保証の更新が適切な場合があり、第6.4.2.3.2節に従って更新できる。秘密鍵所持保証への時間の影響はSP 800-89参照。本勧告の適切な実装の一環として、システム利用者および／またはその信頼された代理人は、所持保証を取得する方法のうち、どれがセキュリティ要件を満たすかを判断するべきである。主体に代わって鍵確立を行うアプリケーションは、使用方法の十分性に関する認識に基づき、トランザクションを進めるか否かを決めるべきである。この情報は明示的にアプリケーションへ提供してもよく、アプリケーション自体の動作から暗黙的に得られてもよい。結合機関が公開鍵受領者である場合：所有者識別子を公開鍵に結び付ける時点で、結合機関（CAなどの信頼できる第三者）は、所有者が正しい秘密鍵を所持する保証を取得しなければならない。この保証は、第6.4.2.3.2節の方法（例えば結合機関自身が公開鍵受領者として動作）または承認済み代替手段（SP 800-57 Part 1第5.2節および第8.1.5.1.1.2節参照）で得なければならない。結合機関の役割を持たない受領者：鍵確立トランザクション自体で必要な目的を超えて導出鍵素材を使用する前に、信頼できる第三者（第6.4.2.3.1節）または所有者（すなわち他方の当事者）から直接（第6.4.2.3.2節）保証を得なければならない。所有者から直接得る場合、本勧告への適合には第6.4.2.3.2節の方法を使用しなければならない。確立した鍵素材をトランザクション外の目的に使う前に所持保証を得るという要件は、スキーム自体が求める目的で、トランザクション中に導出／転送鍵素材の一部を使うことを禁じるものではない。例えば、鍵確認付き鍵合意スキームでは、当事者は（とされる）共有秘密を確立し、鍵素材を導出した後、同じトランザクションの一部として鍵確認計算用MAC鍵に導出鍵素材の一部を使用する。

6.4.2.3.1 Recipient Obtains Assurance from a Trusted Third Party

原本 PDF p.69

6.4.2.3.1 受領者が信頼できる第三者から保証を取得

The recipient of a public key may receive assurance that its owner (i.e., the other party in the key-establishment transaction) is in possession of the correct private key from a trusted third party (trusted by the recipient), either before or during a key-establishment transaction that makes use of that public key. The methods used by a third party trusted by the recipient to obtain that assurance are beyond the scope of this Recommendation (see however, the discussions in Sections 6.4.2.3.2 below and in 8.1.5.1.1.2 of SP 800-57). The recipient of a public key (or agents trusted to act on behalf of the recipient) should know the method(s) used by the third party, in order to determine that the assurance obtained on behalf of the recipient is sufficient and appropriate to meet the security requirements of the recipient’s intended application(s).

The recipient of a public key (or agents trusted to act on the recipient’s behalf) shall determine whether or not using one of the key-establishment schemes in this Recommendation to obtain assurance of possession through key confirmation is sufficient and appropriate to meet the security requirements of the recipient’s intended application(s). Other approved methods (e.g., see Section 5.4.4 of SP 800-57-Part 1) of directly obtaining this assurance of possession from the owner are also allowed. If obtaining assurance of possession directly from the owner is not acceptable, then assurance of possession shall be obtained indirectly as discussed in Section 6.4.2.3.1. Successful key confirmation (performed in the context described in this Recommendation) demonstrates that the correct private key has been used in the key-confirmation provider’s calculations, and thus also provides assurance that the claimed owner is the true owner. The assurance of possession obtained via the key-confirmation schemes identified above may be useful even when the recipient has previously obtained independent assurance that the claimed owner of a public key is indeed its true owner. This may be appropriate in situations where the recipient desires renewed assurance that the owner possesses the correct private key (and that the owner is still able to use it correctly), including situations where there is no access to a trusted party who can provide renewed assurance of the owner’s continued possession of the private key.

7 プリミティブおよび操作

Except for RSADP (see Section 7.1.2), the primitives and operations are defined in this section as if the RSA private keys are in the basic format. Equivalent primitives and operations that employ RSA private keys given in the prime-factor or CRT format are permitted (see Section 7.1.2.3).

7.1 暗号化および復号プリミティブ

RSAEP and RSADP are the basic encryption and decryption primitives from the RSA cryptosystem [RSA 1978] specified in PKCS 1. RSAEP produces ciphertext from plaintext using a public key; RSADP recovers the plaintext from the ciphertext using the corresponding private key. The primitives assume that the RSA public key is valid.

7.1.2 RSADP

原本 PDF p.71

7.1.2 RSADP

RSADP is the decryption primitive. It recovers the plaintext from ciphertext using an RSA private key. The format of the decryption operation depends on the format of the private key: basic, prime factor or CRT. A routine that implements this primitive shall destroy any local copies of the private key, as well as any other potentially sensitive locally stored values used or produced during the execution of the routine (such as any locally stored portions of the plaintext). The destruction of these values shall occur prior to or during any exit from the routine (whether exiting early because of an error or exiting normally, with the output of plaintext).

原本 PDF p.71

7.2.1 RSA Secret-Value Encapsulation (RSASVE)

原本 PDF p.73

7.2.1 RSA秘密値カプセル化（RSASVE）

The RSASVE generate operation is used by one party in a key-establishment transaction to generate and encrypt a secret value to produce ciphertext using the public key-establishment key of the other party. When this ciphertext is received by that other party, and the secret value is recovered (using the RSASVE recover operation and the corresponding private key-establishment key), the secret value is then considered to be a shared secret. Secret-value encapsulation employs a Random Bit Generator (RBG) to generate the secret value. The RSASVE generate and recovery operations specified in Sections 7.2.1.2 and 7.2.1.3, respectively, are based on the RSAEP and RSADP primitives (see Section 7.1). These operations are used by the KAS1 and KAS2 key-agreement families (see Sections 8.2 and 8.3).

原本 PDF p.73

RSASVE生成操作は、鍵確立トランザクションの一方の当事者が、他方の公開鍵確立鍵を使って秘密値を生成・暗号化し、暗号文を作るために用いる。暗号文を他方の当事者が受信し、対応する秘密鍵確立鍵とRSASVE復元操作で秘密値を復元すると、その値を共有秘密とみなす。秘密値カプセル化では乱数ビット生成器（RBG）を用いて秘密値を生成する。第7.2.1.2節および第7.2.1.3節にそれぞれ規定するRSASVE生成・復元操作は、RSAEPおよびRSADPプリミティブ（第7.1節参照）に基づく。これらの操作はKAS1およびKAS2鍵合意ファミリー（第8.2節、第8.3節参照）で用いる。

7.2.2 RSA with Optimal Asymmetric Encryption Padding (RSA-OAEP)

原本 PDF p.76

7.2.2 最適非対称暗号化パディングを用いるRSA（RSA-OAEP）

RSA-OAEP consists of asymmetric encryption and decryption operations that are based on an approved hash function, an approved random bit generator, a mask-generation function, and the RSAEP and RSADP primitives. These operations are used by the KTS-OAEP key-transport scheme (see Section 9.2). In the RSA-OAEP encryption operation, a data block is constructed by the sender (party U) from the keying material to be transported and the hash of additional input (see Section 9.1) that is shared by party U and the intended receiving party (party V). A random byte string is generated, after which both the random byte string and the data block are masked in a way that binds their values. The masked values are used to form the plaintext that is input to the RSAEP primitive, along with the public key-establishment key of party V. The resulting RSAEP output further binds the random byte string, the keying material and the hash of the additional data in the ciphertext that is sent to party V. In the RSA-OAEP decryption operation, the ciphertext and the receiving party’s (i.e., party V’s) private key-establishment key are input to the RSADP primitive, recovering the masked values as output. The mask-generation function is then used to reconstruct and remove the masks that obscure the random byte string and the data block. After removing the masks, party V can examine the format of the recovered data and compare its own computation of the hash of the additional data to the hash value contained in the unmasked data block, thus obtaining some measure of assurance of the integrity of the recovered data – including the transported keying material. RSA-OAEP can process up to nLen – 2HLen – 2 bytes of keying material, where nLen is the byte length of the recipient’s RSA modulus, and HLen is the byte length of the values output by the underlying hash function.

原本 PDF p.76

RSA-OAEPは、承認済みハッシュ関数、承認済み乱数ビット生成器、マスク生成関数、およびRSAEP／RSADPプリミティブに基づく非対称暗号化・復号操作から成る。これらの操作はKTS-OAEP鍵転送スキームで用いる（第9.2節参照）。RSA-OAEP暗号化操作では、送信者（当事者U）が転送対象の鍵素材と、Uおよび意図する受信者（当事者V）が共有する追加入力（第9.1節参照）のハッシュからデータブロックを構成する。ランダムバイト文字列を生成した後、そのランダム文字列とデータブロックの値を結び付ける方法で双方をマスクする。マスク済み値から平文を構成し、当事者Vの公開鍵確立鍵とともにRSAEPプリミティブへ入力する。RSAEP出力により、ランダム文字列、鍵素材および追加入力のハッシュがさらに結び付けられ、当事者Vに送る暗号文となる。RSA-OAEP復号操作では、暗号文と受信者（当事者V）の秘密鍵確立鍵をRSADPプリミティブへ入力し、マスク済み値を出力として復元する。続いてマスク生成関数で、ランダムバイト文字列とデータブロックを隠すマスクを再構成して除去する。マスク除去後、当事者Vは復元データの形式を検査し、追加入力のハッシュを自ら計算した値と、マスク解除済みデータブロックに含まれるハッシュ値を比較できる。これにより、転送鍵素材を含む復元データの完全性について一定の保証を得る。RSA-OAEPは最大nLen − 2HLen − 2バイトの鍵素材を処理できる。nLenは受信者のRSA法のバイト長、HLenは基礎ハッシュ関数が出力する値のバイト長である。

7.2.2.2 The Mask Generation Function (MGF)

原本 PDF p.77

7.2.2.2 マスク生成関数（MGF）

MGF is a mask-generation function based on an approved hash function (see Section 5.1). The purpose of the MGF is to generate a string of bits that may be used to “mask” other bit strings. The MGF is used by the RSA-OAEP-based schemes specified in Section 9.2. Let hash be an approved hash function. For the purposes of this Recommendation, the MGF shall not be invoked more than once by each party during a given transaction using a given MGF seed (i.e., a mask shall be derived only once by each party from a given MGF seed).

原本 PDF p.77

MGFは承認済みハッシュ関数（第5.1節参照）に基づくマスク生成関数である。MGFの目的は、他のビット列を「マスク」するために使えるビット列を生成することである。MGFは第9.2節のRSA-OAEPベースのスキームで用いる。本勧告で承認済みハッシュ関数をhashとする。本勧告では、各当事者は所定のMGFシードを用いるトランザクション中にMGFを1回を超えて呼び出してはならない（すなわち、各当事者は所定のMGFシードからマスクを1回だけ導出する）。

A single error message should be employed and output the same way for each type of decryption error. There should be no difference in the observable behavior for the different RSA-OAEP decryption errors.

2.In addition, care should be taken to ensure that even if there are no errors, an implementation does not reveal partial information about the encoded message em or EM. For instance, the observable behavior of the mask-generation function should not reveal even partial information about the MGF seed employed in the process (since that could compromise portions of the maskedDB′ segment of EM). An opponent who can reliably obtain particular bits of EM for sufficiently many chosen-ciphertext values may be able to obtain the full decryption of an arbitrary ciphertext by applying the bit-security results of Håstad and Näslund [HN 1998].

8 Key-Agreement Schemes

原本 PDF p.84

8 鍵合意スキーム

In a key-agreement scheme, two parties, party U and party V, establish keying material over which neither has complete control of the result, but both have influence. This Recommendation provides two families of key-agreement schemes: KAS1 and KAS2. The KAS1 family consists of the KAS1-basic and KAS1-Party_V-confirmation schemes, and the KAS2 family consists of the KAS2-basic, KAS2-Party_V-confirmation, KAS2-Party_U-confirmation, and KAS2-bilateral-confirmation schemes. These schemes are based on secret-value encapsulation (see Section 7.2.1). Key confirmation is included in some of these schemes to provide assurance that the participants share the same keying material; see Section 5.6 for the details of key confirmation. When possible, each party should have such assurance. Although other methods are often used to provide this assurance, this Recommendation makes no statement as to the adequacy of these other methods. Key confirmation may also provide assurance of private-key possession. For each of the KAS1 and KAS2 schemes, Party V shall have an identifier, ID , that has an

原本 PDF p.84

鍵合意スキームでは、当事者UとVの2者が、結果をどちらも完全には制御できないが双方が影響を与える鍵素材を確立する。本勧告はKAS1およびKAS2の2ファミリーを規定する。KAS1ファミリーはKAS1-basicおよびKAS1-Party_V-confirmationから成り、KAS2ファミリーはKAS2-basic、KAS2-Party_V-confirmation、KAS2-Party_U-confirmation、KAS2-bilateral-confirmationから成る。これらのスキームは秘密値カプセル化（第7.2.1節参照）に基づく。一部のスキームには、参加者が同じ鍵素材を共有する保証を与えるため鍵確認を含む。詳細は第5.6節参照。可能な場合、各当事者はその保証を得るべきである。他の方法で保証を提供することも多いが、本勧告はそれらの適切性を判断しない。鍵確認は秘密鍵所持の保証も提供する場合がある。KAS1およびKAS2の各スキームで、当事者Vは識別子ID_Vを持たなければならず、その識別子は既知または発見可能であり、当事者Uから信頼される鍵ペアとの

A general flow diagram is provided for each key-agreement scheme. The dotted-line arrows represent the distribution of public keys by the parties themselves or by a third party, such as a Certification Authority (CA). The solid-line arrows represent the distribution of nonces or cryptographically protected values that occur during the key-agreement scheme. Note that the flow diagrams in this Recommendation omit explicit mention of various validation checks that are required. The flow diagrams and descriptions in this Recommendation assume a successful completion of the key-agreement process. For each scheme, there are conditions that must be satisfied to enable proper use of that scheme. These conditions are listed as assumptions. Failure to meet all such conditions could yield undesirable results, such as the inability to communicate or the loss of security. As part of the proper implementation of this Recommendation, system users and/or agents trusted to act on their behalf (including application developers, system installers, and system administrators) are responsible for ensuring that all assumptions are satisfied at the time that a key-establishment transaction takes place.

8.2 KAS1 Key Agreement

原本 PDF p.85

8.2 KAS1鍵合意

For the KAS1 key-agreement schemes, even if both parties have key-establishment key pairs, only party V’s key-establishment key pair is used. The KAS1 key-agreement schemes have the following general form:

原本 PDF p.85

KAS1鍵合意スキームでは、双方が鍵確立鍵ペアを持っていても、当事者Vの鍵確立鍵ペアだけを使う。KAS1鍵合意スキームの一般形は次のとおり。

未レビュー訳

1.Party U generates a secret value (which will become a shared secret) and a corresponding ciphertext using the RSASVE.GENERATE operation and party V’s public key-establishment key, and then sends the ciphertext to party V.

原本 PDF p.85

1.当事者UはRSASVE.GENERATE操作と当事者Vの公開鍵確立鍵を用いて秘密値（共有秘密となる）および対応する暗号文を生成し、その暗号文を当事者Vに送る。

未レビュー訳

2.Party V recovers the secret value from the ciphertext using the RSASVE.RECOVER operation and its private key-establishment key; the secret value is then considered to be the shared secret. Party V generates a nonce and sends it to party U.

原本 PDF p.85

2.当事者VはRSASVE.RECOVER操作および自身の秘密鍵確立鍵を使って暗号文から秘密値を復元する。復元した秘密値を共有秘密とみなす。当事者Vはノンスを生成して当事者Uに送る。

未レビュー訳

3.Both parties then derive keying material from the shared secret and “other information”, including party V’s nonce, using a key-derivation method. The length of the keying material that can be agreed on is limited only by the length that can be output by the key-derivation method.

原本 PDF p.85

3.双方の当事者は、その後、鍵導出方法を用いて共有秘密および当事者Vのノンスを含む「その他の情報」から鍵素材を導出する。合意可能な鍵素材の長さは、鍵導出方法が出力できる長さによってのみ制限される。

未レビュー訳

4.If key confirmation (KC) is incorporated into the scheme, then the derived keying material is parsed into two parts, MacKey and KeyData, and a MacData string is formed (see Sections 5.6 and 8.2.3.2.), MacKey and MacData are used to compute a MAC tag of MacTagBits bits (see Sections 5.2.1, 5.2.2, 5.6.1 and 5.6.3), and MacTag is sent from party V (the KC provider) to party U (the KC recipient). If the MAC tag computed by party V matches the MAC tag (re)computed by party U, then the successful establishment of keying material is confirmed to party U.

原本 PDF p.85

4.スキームに鍵確認（KC）を組み込む場合、導出鍵素材をMacKeyとKeyDataの2部分に分け、MacData文字列を作成する（第5.6節および第8.2.3.2節参照）。MacKeyとMacDataを用いてMacTagBitsビットのMACタグを計算し（第5.2.1節、第5.2.2節、第5.6.1節、第5.6.3節参照）、KC提供者の当事者VからKC受領者の当事者UにMacTagを送る。当事者Vが計算したMACタグとUが（再）計算したMACタグが一致すれば、Uに鍵素材の確立成功が確認される。

8.3 KAS2鍵合意

In this family of key-agreement schemes, key-establishment key pairs are used by both party U and party V. The schemes in this family have the following general form:

原本 PDF p.89

この鍵合意スキームファミリーでは、当事者UとVの双方が鍵確立鍵ペアを用いる。このファミリーのスキームの一般形は次のとおり。

未レビュー訳

1.Party U generates a secret value (which will become a component of the shared secret) and a corresponding ciphertext using the RSASVE.GENERATE operation and party V’s public key-establishment key, and sends the ciphertext to party V.

1.当事者UはRSASVE.GENERATE操作と当事者Vの公開鍵確立鍵を用いて、共有秘密の一部となる秘密値および対応する暗号文を生成し、暗号文をVに送る。

未レビュー訳

2.Party V recovers party U’s secret component from the ciphertext received from party U using the RSASVE.RECOVER operation and its private key-establishment key.

原本 PDF p.89

2.当事者VはRSASVE.RECOVER操作と自身の秘密鍵確立鍵を用い、Uから受信した暗号文からUの秘密成分を復元する。

未レビュー訳

3.Party V generates a secret value (which will become a second component of the shared secret) and the corresponding ciphertext using the RSASVE.GENERATE operation and party U’s public key-establishment key, and sends the ciphertext to party U.

原本 PDF p.89

3.当事者VはRSASVE.GENERATE操作と当事者Uの公開鍵確立鍵を用いて、共有秘密の第2の成分となる秘密値および対応する暗号文を生成し、暗号文をUに送る。

未レビュー訳

4.Party U recovers party V’s secret component from the ciphertext received from party V using the RSASVE.RECOVER operation and its private key-establishment key.

原本 PDF p.89

4.当事者UはRSASVE.RECOVER操作と自身の秘密鍵確立鍵を用い、Vから受信した暗号文からVの秘密成分を復元する。

未レビュー訳

5.Both parties concatenate the two secret components to form the shared secret, and then derive keying material from the shared secret and “other information” using a key-derivation method. The length of the keying material that can be agreed on is limited only by the length that can be output by the key-derivation method.

原本 PDF p.89

5.双方は2つの秘密成分を連結して共有秘密を形成し、鍵導出方法を用いて共有秘密と「その他の情報」から鍵素材を導出する。合意可能な鍵素材の長さは鍵導出方法が出力できる長さによってのみ制限される。

未レビュー訳

6.Party U and/or party V may additionally provide key confirmation. If key confirmation is incorporated, then the derived keying material is parsed into two parts, MacKey and KeyData. MacKey is then used to compute a MAC tag of MacTagLen bytes on MacData (see Sections 5.2.1, 5.2.2, 5.6.1 and 5.6.3). Key confirmation may be either unilateral or bilateral. When key confirmation is performed, a MacTag is sent from a KC provider to a KC recipient.

原本 PDF p.89

6.当事者Uおよび／またはVはさらに鍵確認を提供してもよい。鍵確認を組み込む場合、導出鍵素材をMacKeyとKeyDataの2つの部分に解析する。次に、MacKeyを用いてMacDataに対するMacTagLenバイトのMACタグを計算する（第5.2.1節、第5.2.2節、第5.6.1節および第5.6.3節参照）。鍵確認は一方向でも双方向でもよい。鍵確認を実施する場合、KC提供者からKC受領者にMacTagを送る。

When unilateral key confirmation in performed: One party assumes the role of the KC provider, and the other party assumes the role of the KC recipient. If the MAC tag computed by the provider matches the MAC tag computed by the recipient, then the successful establishment of keying material is confirmed by the recipient.

原本 PDF p.89

一方向鍵確認を行う場合、一方がKC提供者、他方がKC受領者となる。提供者の計算したMACタグと受領者の計算したMACタグが一致すれば、受領者は鍵素材の確立成功を確認する。

未レビュー訳

When bilateral key confirmation is performed: The key confirmation process requires two interactions (e.g., two messages). In the first interaction, one party assumes the role of the KC provider, and the other party assumes the role of the KC recipient. In the second interaction, the roles are reversed. If each party acting as a recipient determines that the computed MAC tag matches the MAC tag provided by the other party (acting as the provider), then the successful establishment of keying material is confirmed by both parties, and each party has obtained assurance that the other party has actively participated in the transaction.

原本 PDF p.90

双方向鍵確認を行う場合、鍵確認プロセスは2回のやり取り（例えば2つのメッセージ）を必要とする。1回目は一方がKC提供者、他方がKC受領者となり、2回目は役割を逆にする。受領者として動作する各当事者が計算したMACタグと他方（提供者として動作）が送ったMACタグの一致を確認すれば、双方が鍵素材の確立成功を確認し、相手がトランザクションに能動的に参加した保証を得る。

8.3.3.4 KAS2-bilateral-confirmation

Figure 11 depicts a typical flow for a KAS2 scheme with bilateral key confirmation. In this scheme, party U and party V assume the roles of both the KC provider and recipient in order to obtain bilateral key confirmation. The successful completion of the key-confirmation process provides each party with a) assurance that other party has derived the same secret Z value, and b) assurance that the other party has actively participated in the process.

原本 PDF p.96

図11は双方向鍵確認を伴うKAS2スキームの典型的な流れを示す。このスキームでは、UとVの双方がKC提供者と受領者の役割を担い、双方向鍵確認を行う。鍵確認プロセスが正常に完了すると、各当事者はa)相手が同じ秘密値Zを導出し、b)相手がプロセスに能動的に参加した保証を得る。

9 Key-Transport Schemes

原本 PDF p.98

9 鍵転送スキーム

未レビュー訳

In a key-transport scheme, two parties, the sender and receiver, establish keying material selected by the sender. The keying material may be cryptographically bound to additional input (see Section 9.1). In this Recommendation, the KTS-OAEP family of key-transport schemes is specified (see Section 9.2). In addition, a hybrid method for key transport is discussed whereby a key-establishment scheme specified in this Recommendation is followed by a key-wrapping scheme (see Section 9.3). Key confirmation is included in one of the KTS-OAEP schemes to provide assurance to the sender that the participants share the same keying material (see Section 5.6 for further details on key confirmation). A general flow diagram is provided for each KTS-OAEP key-transport scheme. The dotted-line arrows represent the distribution of public keys by the parties themselves or by a third party, such as a Certification Authority (CA). The solid-line arrows represent the distribution of cryptographically protected values that occur during the key-transport or key-confirmation process. Note that the flow diagrams in this Recommendation omit explicit mention of various validation checks that are required. The flow diagrams and descriptions in this Recommendation assume a successful completion of the key-transport process. As in Section 8, there are conditions that must be satisfied for each key-transport scheme to enable the proper use of that scheme. These conditions are listed as assumptions. Failure to meet any of these conditions could yield undesirable results, such as the inability to communicate or the loss of security. As part of the proper implementation of this Recommendation, system users and/or agents trusted to act on their behalf (including application developers, system installers, and system administrators) are responsible for ensuring that all assumptions are satisfied at the time that a key-establishment transaction takes place.

原本 PDF p.98

鍵転送スキームでは、送信者と受信者の2者が、送信者が選択した鍵素材を確立する。鍵素材は追加入力に暗号学的に結び付けてもよい（第9.1節参照）。本勧告ではKTS-OAEPファミリーの鍵転送スキームを規定する（第9.2節参照）。さらに、本勧告で規定する鍵確立スキームの後に鍵ラッピングスキームを用いるハイブリッド鍵転送方式を説明する（第9.3節参照）。KTS-OAEPスキームの1つには、参加者が同じ鍵素材を共有する保証を送信者に提供するため鍵確認を含める（詳細は第5.6節参照）。各KTS-OAEP鍵転送スキームに一般的なフロー図を示す。点線矢印は当事者自身またはCAなどの第三者による公開鍵配布を表す。実線矢印は鍵転送または鍵確認プロセス中に配布される暗号学的に保護された値を表す。本勧告のフロー図では、必要な各種検証確認を明記していない。図と説明は鍵転送プロセスが正常に完了することを仮定する。第8節と同様に、鍵転送スキームを適切に使用するには満たすべき条件があり、仮定として列挙する。これらの条件を満たさないと、通信不能またはセキュリティ喪失など望ましくない結果を招く可能性がある。本勧告を適切に実装するため、システム利用者および／またはその代理として行動する信頼された者（アプリケーション開発者、システム設置者、システム管理者を含む）は、鍵確立トランザクション時にすべての仮定が満たされていることを確保する責任を負う。

未レビュー訳

9.1 Additional Input

原本 PDF p.98

9.1 追加入力

Additional input to the key-transport process may be employed to ensure that the keying material is adequately “bound” to the context of the key-transport transaction. The use of additional input, A, is explicitly supported by the key-transport schemes specified in Section 9.2. Each party to a key-transport transaction shall know whether or not additional input is employed in that transaction. Context-specific information that may be appropriate for inclusion in the additional input is listed in Section 5.5.2. (The suggestions for the content of FixedfInfo apply to the additional input as well.) Both parties to the key-transport transaction shall know the format of the additional input, A, and shall acquire A in time to use it as required by the scheme. The methods used for formatting and distributing the additional input are application-defined. System users and/or agents trusted to act on their behalf should determine that the information selected for inclusion in A and the methods used for formatting and distributing A meet the security requirements of those users.

原本 PDF p.98

鍵転送プロセスでは、鍵素材を鍵転送トランザクションのコンテキストに適切に「結び付ける」ため、追加入力を使用してもよい。第9.2節の鍵転送スキームは追加入力Aを明示的にサポートする。鍵転送トランザクションの各当事者は、そのトランザクションで追加入力を用いるか否かを把握していなければならない。追加入力に含めるのが適切なコンテキスト固有情報を第5.5.2節に列挙する（FixedInfoの内容に関する提案は追加入力にも適用される）。両当事者は追加入力Aの形式を知り、スキームの要求に応じて利用できるよう適時にAを取得しなければならない。追加入力の形式設定および配布方法はアプリケーションで定義する。システム利用者および／または信頼された代理人は、Aに含める情報とAの形式設定・配布方法がセキュリティ要件を満たすと判断するべきである。

未レビュー訳

9.2 KTS-OAEP: Key-Transport Using RSA-OAEP

原本 PDF p.99

9.2 KTS-OAEP：RSA-OAEPを用いる鍵転送

The KTS-OAEP family of key-transport schemes is based on the RSA-OAEP encrypt and decrypt operations (see Section 7.2.2), which are, in turn, based on the asymmetric encryption and decryption primitives, RSAEP and RSADP (see Section 7.1). In this family, only party V’s key pair is used. The key-transport schemes of this family have the following general form:

原本 PDF p.99

KTS-OAEPファミリーの鍵転送スキームはRSA-OAEP暗号化・復号操作（第7.2.2節参照）に基づき、これらの操作は非対称暗号化・復号プリミティブRSAEPおよびRSADPに基づく（第7.1節参照）。このファミリーでは当事者Vの鍵ペアだけを用いる。スキームの一般形は次のとおり。

未レビュー訳

1.Party U (the sender) encrypts the keying material (and possibly additional input – see Section 7.2.2.3) to be transported using the RSA-OAEP.ENCRYPT operation and party V’s (the receiver’s) public key-establishment key to produce ciphertext, and sends the ciphertext to party V.

原本 PDF p.99

1.当事者U（送信者）はRSA-OAEP.ENCRYPT操作と当事者V（受信者）の公開鍵確立鍵を用いて、転送対象の鍵素材（および追加入力の場合はそれも。第7.2.2.3節参照）を暗号化して暗号文を作り、Vに送る。

未レビュー訳

2.Party V decrypts the ciphertext using its private key-establishment key and the RSA-OAEP.DECRYPT operation to recover the transported keying material (see Section 7.2.2.4).

原本 PDF p.99

2.当事者Vは自身の秘密鍵確立鍵とRSA-OAEP.DECRYPT操作で暗号文を復号し、転送された鍵素材を復元する（第7.2.2.4節参照）。

未レビュー訳

3.If key confirmation is incorporated, then the transported keying material is parsed into two parts, a transaction-specific (random) value for MacKey, followed by KeyData (see Section 5.6.1). The Mackey portion of the keying material and an approved MAC algorithm are used by each party to compute a MAC tag (of an appropriate, agreed-upon length) on what should be the same MacData (see Sections 5.6 and 9.2.4.2). The MAC tag computed by party V (the key-confirmation provider) is sent to party U (the key-confirmation recipient). If the value of the MAC tag sent by party V matches the MAC tag value computed by party U, then party U obtains a confirmation of the success of the key-transport transaction.

原本 PDF p.99

3.鍵確認を組み込む場合、転送鍵素材をトランザクション固有のランダム値MacKeyと、その後に続くKeyDataの2部分に解析する（第5.6.1節参照）。双方の当事者は鍵素材のMacKey部分と承認済みMACアルゴリズムを用い、同一であるべきMacDataに対するMACタグを合意済みの適切な長さで計算する（第5.6節および第9.2.4.2節参照）。当事者V（鍵確認提供者）が計算したMACタグを当事者U（鍵確認受領者）に送る。VのMACタグ値とUが計算した値が一致すれば、Uは鍵転送トランザクションの成功を確認する。

The common components of the schemes in the KTS-OAEP family are listed in Section 9.2.2. The following schemes are then defined:

9.2.1 KTS-OAEPの仮定

1.Party V has been designated as the owner of a key-establishment key pair that was generated as specified in Section 6.3. Party V has obtained assurance of its possession of the correct value for its private key as specified in Section 6.4.1.5.

未レビュー訳

2.The parties have agreed upon an approved hash function, hash, appropriate for use with the mask-generation function used by RSA-OAEP, as well as an approved hash function, H, used to hash the additional input (see Sections 5.1, and 7.2.2). The same hash function may be used for both functions.

3.Prior to or during the transport process, the sender and receiver have either agreed upon the form and content of the additional input A (a byte string to be cryptographically bound to the transported keying material so that the ciphertext is a function of both values), or agreed that A will be a null string (see Section 9.1).

9.3 Hybrid Key-Transport Methods

原本 PDF p.103

9.3 ハイブリッド鍵転送方式

Key transport may be accomplished following any of the key-establishment schemes in this Recommendation (i.e, any KAS1, KAS2 or KTS-OAEP scheme) by using an approved key-wrapping algorithm (see SP 800-38F25) with a key-wrapping key established during the execution of that key-establishment scheme. The security properties for this hybrid key-establishment process depend on the key-establishment scheme, the key-wrapping algorithm and the communication protocol used; the roles assumed by the participants during the process; and all other parameters used during the entire process.

原本 PDF p.103

本勧告の任意の鍵確立スキーム（KAS1、KAS2またはKTS-OAEP）に続けて、そのスキームの実行中に確立した鍵ラッピング鍵と承認済み鍵ラッピングアルゴリズム（SP 800-38F²⁵参照）を用いることで鍵転送を実現できる。このハイブリッド鍵確立プロセスのセキュリティ特性は、鍵確立スキーム、鍵ラッピングアルゴリズム、通信プロトコル、参加者の役割、および全プロセスで使うその他すべてのパラメータに依存する。

10 Rationale for Selecting a Specific Scheme

原本 PDF p.104

10 特定のスキームを選ぶ根拠

The subsections that follow describe the security properties that may be considered when a user and/or developer is choosing a key-establishment scheme from among the various schemes described in this Recommendation. The descriptions are intended to highlight certain similarities and differences between families of key-establishment schemes and/or between schemes within a particular family; they do not constitute an in-depth analysis of all possible security properties of every scheme under all adversary models. The (brief) discussions will focus on the extent to which each participant in a particular transaction has assurance that fresh keying material has been successfully established with the intended party (and no one else). To that end, it is important to distinguish between the actual identifier of a participant in a key-establishment transaction and the role (party U or party V) assumed by that participant during the transaction. To simplify matters, in what follows, assume that the actual identifiers of the (honest) participants in a key-establishment transaction are the proverbial “Alice,” acting as party U, and “Bob,” acting as party V. (Pretend, for the sake of discussion, that these identifiers are unique among the universe of possible participants.) The identifier associated with their malevolent adversary is “Eve.” The discussions will also consider the ill effects of certain compromises that might occur. The basic security properties that are cited depend on such factors as how a shared secret is calculated, how keying material is established, and what types of key-confirmation (if any) are incorporated into a given scheme. Note 1: In order to provide concise descriptions of security properties possessed by the various schemes, it is necessary to make some assumptions concerning the format and type of data that is used as input during key derivation. The following assumptions are made solely for the purposes of Sections 10.1 through 10.3; they are not intended to preclude the options specified elsewhere in this Recommendation.

原本 PDF p.104

以下の小節では、本勧告で説明する複数の鍵確立スキームから利用者および／または開発者が選択する際に考慮し得るセキュリティ特性を説明する。説明は、鍵確立スキームのファミリー間または各ファミリー内のスキーム間にある特定の類似点・相違点を示すものであり、あらゆる攻撃者モデルの下ですべてのスキームの全セキュリティ特性を詳細に分析するものではない。簡潔な考察では、各トランザクションの参加者が意図した相手（他の誰でもない）と新鮮な鍵素材を正常に確立できたという保証の程度に焦点を当てる。そのため、鍵確立トランザクションの参加者の実際の識別子と、トランザクション中にその参加者が担う役割（当事者UまたはV）を区別することが重要である。簡単のため、以下では（正直な）参加者の実際の識別子を、Uとして動作する「Alice」とVとして動作する「Bob」とする（説明上、これらの識別子は参加者全体で一意と仮定する）。悪意ある攻撃者の識別子は「Eve」とする。また、発生し得る特定の侵害による悪影響も考察する。挙げる基本的セキュリティ特性は、共有秘密の計算方法、鍵素材の確立方法、スキームに組み込む鍵確認の種類（あれば）などに依存する。注1：各スキームのセキュリティ特性を簡潔に記述するため、鍵導出入力データの形式と種類について仮定が必要である。以下の仮定は第10.1節から第10.3節の目的に限って用い、本勧告の他の箇所で指定する選択肢を排除しない。

1.When discussing the security properties of schemes, it is assumed that the FixedInfo input to a (single-step) key-derivation function employed during a particular key-agreement transaction uses either the concatenation format or the ASN.1 format (see Section 5.5). It is also assumed that FixedInfo includes sufficiently specific identifiers for the participants in the transaction, an identifier for the key-establishment scheme being used during the transaction, and additional input (e.g., a nonce, and/or session identifier) that may provide assurance to one or both participants that the derived keying material will reflect the specific context in which the transaction occurs (see Section 5.5 and Appendix B of SP 800-56A for further discussion concerning context-specific information that may be appropriate for inclusion in FixedInfo).

Note 2: Different schemes may possess different security properties. A scheme should be selected based on how well the scheme fulfills system requirements. For instance, if messages are exchanged over a large-scale network where each exchange consumes a considerable amount of time, a scheme with fewer exchanges during a single key-agreement transaction might be preferable to a scheme with more exchanges, even though the latter may possess more security benefits. It is important to keep in mind that a key-establishment scheme is usually a component of a larger protocol that may offer security-related assurances beyond those that can be provided by the key-establishment scheme alone. For example, the protocol may include specific features that limit opportunities for accidental or intentional misuse of the key-establishment component of the protocol. Protocols, per se, are not specified in this Recommendation.

注2：スキームごとにセキュリティ特性は異なり得る。スキームはシステム要件への適合度に基づいて選択するべきである。例えば、大規模ネットワーク上のメッセージ交換に多大な時間がかかる場合、単一鍵合意トランザクションで交換回数の多いスキームより、交換回数の少ないスキームが望ましいことがある。後者の方がセキュリティ上の利点を多く持つとしても同様である。鍵確立スキームは通常、より大きなプロトコルの一部であり、そのプロトコルはスキーム単独で提供できる以上のセキュリティ保証を提供することがある。例えばプロトコルには、鍵確立要素の偶発的または意図的な誤用機会を制限する機能を含み得る。本勧告はプロトコル自体を規定しない。

10.1 Rationale for Choosing a KAS1 Key-Agreement Scheme

原本 PDF p.105

10.1 KAS1鍵合意スキームを選ぶ根拠

In both schemes included in the KAS1 family, only Bob (assumed to be acting as party V) is required to own an RSA key pair that is used in the key-agreement transaction. Assume that the identifier used to label party V during the transaction is one that is associated with Bob’s RSA public key in a manner that is trusted by Alice (who is acting as party U). This can provide Alice with some level of assurance that she has correctly identified the party with whom she will be establishing keying material if the transaction is successfully completed. Each KAS1 scheme requires Alice to employ the RSASVE.GENERATE operation to select a (random) secret value Z and encrypt it as ciphertext C using Bob’s RSA public key. Unless Bob’s corresponding private key has been compromised, Alice has assurance that no unintended entity (i.e., no one but Bob) could employ the RSASVE.RECOVER operation to obtain Z from C. Absent the compromise of Bob’s RSA private key and/or Z, Alice may attain a certain level of confidence that she has correctly identified party V as Bob. Alice’s level of confidence is dependent upon:

原本 PDF p.105

KAS1ファミリーの両スキームでは、鍵合意トランザクションで使用するRSA鍵ペアを所有する必要があるのはBob（当事者Vと仮定）のみである。トランザクションでVを表す識別子は、Alice（当事者U）が信頼する方法でBobのRSA公開鍵に関連付けられていると仮定する。これによりトランザクションが正常完了した場合、Aliceは鍵素材を確立する相手を正しく識別したとの一定の保証を得られる。各KAS1スキームでAliceはRSASVE.GENERATE操作を使って（ランダムな）秘密値Zを選び、BobのRSA公開鍵で暗号化して暗号文Cにする必要がある。Bobの対応する秘密鍵が侵害されていなければ、Bob以外の意図しない主体がRSASVE.RECOVERを使ってCからZを得ることはできないとAliceは保証される。Bobの秘密鍵および／またはZが侵害されていなければ、AliceはVをBobと正しく識別した確信を一定程度得られる。その確信の程度は次に依存する。

未レビュー訳

•The specificity of the identifier that is associated with Bob’s RSA public key,

In general, Bob has no assurance that party U is Alice, since Bob has no assurance concerning the accuracy of any identifier that may be used to label party U (unless, for example, the protocol using a key-agreement scheme from the KAS1 family also includes additional elements that establish a trusted association between an identifier for Alice and the ciphertext C that she contributes to the transaction while acting as party U). The assurance of freshness of the derived keying material that can be obtained by a participant in a KAS1 transaction is commensurate with the participant’s assurance that different input will be supplied to the agreed-upon key-derivation method during each such transaction. Alice can obtain assurance that fresh keying material will be derived based on her unilateral selection and contribution of the random Z value. Bob can obtain similar assurance owing to his selection and contribution of the nonce N , which is also used as input to the agreed-upon key-derivation method.

Consequently, when the KAS1-Party_V-confirmation scheme is employed during a particular key-agreement transaction (and neither Z nor Bob’s RSA private key has been compromised), Alice can obtain assurance of the active (and successful) participation by Bob in the transaction. The acquisition of Bob’s RSA private key by their adversary, Eve, may lead to the compromise of shared secrets and derived keying material from past, current, and future legitimate transactions (i.e., transactions that involve honest parties and are not actively influenced by an adversary) that employ the compromised private key. For example, Eve may be able to compromise a particular KAS1 transaction between Alice and Bob as long as she acquires the ciphertext, C, contributed by Alice and the nonce, N , contributed by Bob (as well as any other data used as input during key

In addition to compromising legitimate KAS1 transactions, once Eve has learned Bob’s RSA private key, she may be able to impersonate Bob while acting as party V in future KAS1 transactions (with Alice or any other party). Other schemes and applications that rely on the compromised private key may also be adversely affected. (See the appropriate subsection for details.) Even without knowledge of Bob’s private key, if Eve learns the value of Z that has been (or will be) used in a particular KAS1 transaction between Alice and Bob, then she may be able to derive the keying material resulting from that transaction as easily as Alice and Bob (as long as Eve also acquires the value of N and any other data used as input during key derivation). 10.2 Rationale for Choosing a KAS2 Key-Agreement Scheme

原本 PDF p.107

10.2 KAS2鍵合意スキームを選ぶ根拠

未レビュー訳

In the schemes included in the KAS2 family, both Alice (assumed to be acting as party U) and Bob (assumed to be acting as party V) are required to own an RSA key pair that is used in their key-agreement transaction. Assume that the identifier used to label party V during the transaction is one that is associated with Bob’s RSA public key in a manner that is trusted by Alice. Similarly, assume that the identifier used to label party U during the transaction is one that is associated with Alice’s RSA public key in a manner that is trusted by Bob. This can provide each party with some level of assurance concerning the identifier of the other party, with whom keying material will be established if the transaction is successfully completed. Each KAS2 scheme requires Alice to employ the RSASVE.GENERATE operation to select a (random) secret value Z and encrypt it as ciphertext C using Bob’s RSA public key. Unless

原本 PDF p.107

KAS2ファミリーのスキームでは、Alice（当事者Uと仮定）とBob（当事者Vと仮定）の双方が、鍵合意トランザクションで用いるRSA鍵ペアを所有する必要がある。トランザクション中にVを表す識別子はAliceが信頼する方法でBobのRSA公開鍵に関連付けられ、Uを表す識別子はBobが信頼する方法でAliceのRSA公開鍵に関連付けられていると仮定する。これにより、トランザクションが正常に完了すれば双方が鍵素材を確立する相手の識別子について一定の保証を得る。各KAS2スキームでAliceはRSASVE.GENERATEにより（ランダムな）秘密値Z_Uを選択し、BobのRSA公開鍵で暗号化して暗号文C_Uにする。Bobの対応する秘密鍵が侵害されていなければ、Bob以外の意図しない主体がRSASVE.RECOVERでC_UからZ_Uを得られないとAliceは保証される。

V Evidence that keying material has been correctly derived may be provided by using one of the three schemes from the KAS2 family that incorporates key confirmation. The KAS2-Party_V-confirmation scheme permits party V (Bob) to provide evidence of correct key derivation to party U (Alice); the KAS2-Party_U-confirmation scheme permits party U (Alice) to provide evidence of correct key derivation to party V (Bob); the KAS2-bilateral-confirmation scheme permits each party to provide evidence of correct key derivation to the other party. When the KAS2-Party_V-confirmation scheme or the KAS2-bilateral-confirmation scheme is employed during a key-agreement transaction, party V provides a key-confirmation MAC tag, MacTag , to party U as specified in Section 8.3.3.2 or Section 8.3.3.4, respectively. The acquisition of a single RSA private key by their adversary, Eve, will not (by itself) lead to the compromise of derived keying material from legitimate KAS2 transactions between Alice and Bob that employ the compromised RSA key pair. (In this context, a “legitimate transaction” is one in which Alice and Bob act honestly, and there is no active influence exerted by Eve.) 10.3 Rationale for Choosing a KTS-OAEP Key-Transport Scheme

原本 PDF p.109

10.3 KTS-OAEP鍵転送スキームを選ぶ根拠

In each of the key-transport schemes included in the KTS-OAEP family, only Bob (assumed to be acting as party V, the key-transport receiver) is required to own an RSA key pair that is used in the transaction. Assume that the identifier used to label party V during the transaction is one that is associated with Bob’s RSA public key in a manner that is trusted by Alice (who is acting as party U, the key-transport sender). This can provide Alice with some level of assurance that she has correctly identified the party with whom she will be establishing keying material if the key-transport transaction is successfully completed.

原本 PDF p.109

KTS-OAEPファミリーの各鍵転送スキームでは、トランザクションで使うRSA鍵ペアを所有する必要があるのはBob（当事者V、鍵転送受信者と仮定）のみである。トランザクションでVを表す識別子は、Alice（当事者U、鍵転送送信者）が信頼する方法でBobのRSA公開鍵に関連付けられていると仮定する。これにより鍵転送トランザクションが正常完了した場合、Aliceは鍵素材を確立する相手を正しく識別した一定の保証を得られる。

未レビュー訳

Each KTS-OAEP scheme requires Alice to employ the RSA-OAEP.ENCRYPT operation to encrypt the selected keying material (and any additional input) as ciphertext C, using Bob’s RSA public key. Unless Bob’s corresponding private key has been compromised, Alice has assurance that no unintended entity (i.e., no one but Bob) could employ the RSA-OAEP.DECRYPT operation to obtain the transported keying material from C. Absent the compromise of Bob’s RSA private key (or some compromise of the keying material itself – perhaps prior to transport), Alice may attain a certain level of confidence that she has correctly identified party V as Bob. Alice’s level of confidence is commensurate with:

原本 PDF p.110

各KTS-OAEPスキームでAliceはRSA-OAEP.ENCRYPT操作を用い、選択した鍵素材（および追加入力があればそれも）をBobのRSA公開鍵で暗号化して暗号文Cにする。Bobの対応秘密鍵が侵害されていなければ、Bob以外の意図しない主体がRSA-OAEP.DECRYPTによりCから転送鍵素材を得ることはできないとAliceは保証される。BobのRSA秘密鍵または鍵素材自体（転送前など）が侵害されていない限り、AliceはVをBobと正しく識別した確信を一定程度得られる。その確信は次に応じる。

•The specificity of the identifier that is associated with Bob’s RSA public key,

原本 PDF p.110

•公開鍵の妥当性保証。

•The availability of evidence that the transported keying material has been correctly recovered from C by Bob, e.g., through key confirmation, with Bob as the provider.

In general, Bob has no assurance that party U is Alice, since Bob has no assurance concerning the accuracy of any identifier that may be used to label party U (unless, for example, the protocol using a key-transport scheme from the KTS-OAEP family also includes additional elements that establish a trusted association between an identifier for Alice and the ciphertext, C, that she sends to Bob while acting as party U). Due to Alice’s unilateral selection of the keying material, only she can obtain assurance of its freshness. (Her level of confidence concerning its freshness is dependent upon the actual manner in which the keying material is generated by/for her.) Given that Bob simply accepts the keying material that is transported to him by Alice, he has no assurance that it is fresh. The randomized plaintext encoding used during the RSA-OAEP.ENCRYPT operation can provide assurance to Alice that the value of C will change from one KTS-OAEP transaction with Bob to the next, which may help obfuscate the occurrence of a repeated transport of the same keying material from Alice to Bob, should that ever be necessary. The KTS-OAEP-Party_V-confirmation scheme permits party V to provide evidence to party U that keying material has been correctly recovered from the ciphertext C. When the KTS-OAEP-Party_V-confirmation scheme is employed during a key-transport transaction, party V provides a key-confirmation MAC tag (MacTag ) to party U as specified in Section 9.2.4.2. This allows

The acquisition of Bob’s RSA private key by their adversary, Eve, may lead to the compromise of keying material established during past, current, and future legitimate transactions (i.e., transactions that involve honest parties and are not actively influenced by an adversary) that employ the compromised private key. For example, Eve may be able to compromise a particular KTS-OAEP transaction between Alice and Bob, as long as she also acquires the ciphertext, C, sent from Alice to Bob. In addition to compromising legitimate KTS-OAEP transactions, once Eve has learned Bob’s RSA private key, she may be able to impersonate Bob while acting as party V in future KTS-OAEP transactions (with Alice or any other party). Other schemes and applications that rely on the compromised private key may also be adversely affected. (See the discussions of other schemes in this section.) Even without knowledge of Bob’s private key, if the KTS-OAEP-Party_V-confirmation scheme is used during a particular key-transport transaction, and Eve learns the value of MacKey that Alice will send to Bob, then it may be possible for Eve to mislead Alice about Bob’s (active and successful) participation. As long as Eve also acquires the value of C intended for Bob (and any other data needed to form MacData ), it may be possible for Eve to correctly compute MacTagV V and return it to Alice as if it had come from Bob (who may not even be aware that Alice has initiated a transaction with him). Such circumstances could arise, for example, if (in violation of this Recommendation) Alice were to use the same MAC key while attempting to transport keying material to multiple parties (including both Bob and Eve).

敵対者EveがBobのRSA秘密鍵を取得すると、その侵害鍵を使う過去、現在および将来の正当なトランザクション（正直な当事者が攻撃者から能動的影響を受けずに行うトランザクション）で確立した鍵素材が侵害され得る。例えばAliceからBobに送った暗号文CもEveが入手すれば、AliceとBob間の特定のKTS-OAEPトランザクションを侵害できる場合がある。正当なKTS-OAEPトランザクションを侵害するほか、BobのRSA秘密鍵を知ったEveは、将来KTS-OAEPでVとしてBobになりすませる場合がある。他のスキームやアプリケーションも侵害された秘密鍵に依存していれば悪影響を受け得る（本節の他のスキームの説明参照）。Bobの秘密鍵を知らなくても、特定の鍵転送トランザクションでKTS-OAEP-Party_V-confirmationを用い、AliceがBobに送るMacKeyをEveが知れば、Bobが能動的かつ正常に参加したとAliceに誤信させられる場合がある。Bob宛てのC（およびMacData作成に必要な他のデータ）もEveが取得すれば、MacTag_Vを正しく計算し、Bobから来たようにAliceへ返せる場合がある（BobはAliceがトランザクションを開始したことに気付かない可能性もある）。例えば、本勧告に違反してAliceがBobとEveを含む複数相手に鍵素材を転送する際、同じMAC鍵を使った場合にこうした事態が起こり得る。

10.4 Summary of Assurances Associated with Key-Establishment Schemes

原本 PDF p.111

10.4 鍵確立スキームに伴う保証の概要

The security-related features discussed in the preceding subsections of Section 10 can be summarized in terms of the following types of assurance that may be obtained when participating in a key-establishment transaction.

原本 PDF p.111

第10節の前各小節で論じたセキュリティ機能を、鍵確立トランザクションへの参加時に得られる次の種類の保証として要約できる。

•Implicit Key Authentication (IKA): In the case of a key-agreement scheme from the KAS1 or KAS2 family, this is the assurance obtained by one party in a key-agreement transaction that only a specifically identified entity (the intended second party in that transaction) could also derive the key(s) of interest. In the case of a key-transport scheme from the KTS-OAEP family, this is the assurance obtained by the sender that only a specifically identified entity (the intended receiver in that transaction) could successfully decrypt the encrypted keying material to obtain the key(s) of interest.

原本 PDF p.111

•暗黙的鍵認証（IKA）：KAS1またはKAS2ファミリーの鍵合意スキームでは、鍵合意トランザクションの一方の当事者が、特定の識別された主体（そのトランザクションで意図する第二の当事者）だけが対象鍵を同様に導出できるという保証を得ることをいう。KTS-OAEPファミリーの鍵転送スキームでは、送信者が、特定の識別された主体（そのトランザクションで意図する受信者）だけが暗号化された鍵素材を正常に復号して対象鍵を得られるという保証を得ることをいう。

•Key Freshness (KF): This is the assurance obtained by one party in a key-establishment transaction that keying material established during that transaction is statistically

原本 PDF p.111

•鍵の新鮮性（KF）：鍵確立トランザクションで確立した鍵素材が、当該参加者の以前の鍵確立トランザクションで確立した鍵素材と統計的に

未レビュー訳

independent of the keying material established during that party’s previous key-establishment transactions.

原本 PDF p.112

独立しているという保証を参加者が得ること。

未レビュー訳

•Key Confirmation (KC): This is the assurance obtained by one party in a key-establishment transaction that a specifically identified entity (the intended second party in that key-establishment transaction) has correctly acquired and is able to use, the key(s) of interest.

原本 PDF p.112

•鍵確認（KC）：鍵確立トランザクションの一方が、特定の識別された主体（当該トランザクションで意図する相手）が対象鍵を正しく取得し、使用できる保証を得ること。

未レビュー訳

Notes: A participant in a key-establishment transaction cannot hope to distinguish between the actions of another entity and the actions of those who share knowledge of that entity’s private key-establishment key and/or any other secret data sufficient for that entity’s successful participation in a particular key-agreement transaction. In what follows, references to a “specifically identified entity” must be interpreted as an umbrella term including all those who are legitimately in possession of that entity’s private key, etc., and are trusted to act on the entity’s behalf. Any assurance obtained with respect to the actions of a specifically identified entity is conditioned upon the assumption that the identified entity’s relevant private/secret data has not been misused by a trusted party or compromised by an adversary. IKA assurance, as used in this Recommendation, does not address the potential compromise of established keying material owing to such problems as improper storage, the failure to prevent the leakage of sensitive information during computations involving the established keys, and/or inadequate methods for the timely destruction of sensitive data (including the keys themselves). These are just a few examples of misuse, mishandling, side-channel leakage, etc. that could lead to an eventual compromise. In the definition of KC assurance, this Recommendation’s requirement that it be a specifically identified entity who demonstrates the ability to use (some portion of) the established keying material is a stricter condition than is sometimes found in the literature. In this Recommendation, KC assurance presupposes IKA assurance with respect to (at least) the MAC key used in the key-confirmation computations. KC assurance can be obtained by employing a key-establishment scheme that includes key-confirmation as specified in this Recommendation. In particular, the KC provider is expected to use an RSA private key, and the KC recipient is expected to contribute random/ephemeral data that affects the values of both the MacKey and the MacData used to compute a key-confirmation MacTag.

原本 PDF p.112

注：鍵確立トランザクションの参加者は、他の主体と、その主体の秘密鍵確立鍵および／または当該主体の参加成功に十分な他の秘密データを共有する者の行動を区別できない。以下で「特定の識別された主体」という場合、その主体の秘密鍵などを正当に所持し、その代理として行動することを信頼された者すべてを含む包括的な用語として解釈する。本勧告で得る保証は、特定された主体の関連する秘密鍵等が信頼された者に悪用されたり攻撃者に侵害されたりしていないとの仮定に基づく。本勧告におけるIKA保証は、不適切な保存、確立済み鍵の計算中の機微情報漏えい防止の不備、機微データ（鍵自体を含む）の適時破棄方法の不備などによる確立鍵素材の侵害可能性を扱わない。これらは悪用、不適切な取扱い、サイドチャネル漏えい等を通じて最終的な侵害につながる例の一部にすぎない。KC保証の定義では、確立鍵素材の（一部を）使用できる能力を示すのが特定の識別された主体であるとの要件を置き、文献で見られる場合より厳しい条件としている。本勧告では、KC保証は鍵確認計算に用いる少なくともMAC鍵に関するIKA保証を前提とする。本勧告で規定する鍵確認を含む鍵確立スキームでKC保証を得られる。特にKC提供者はRSA秘密鍵を用い、KC受領者は鍵確認MacTag計算に用いるMacKeyとMacDataの双方の値に影響するランダム／一時データを提供することを想定する。

KTS-OAEP9.2および10.3UUU
未レビュー訳

In key-agreement transactions that employ a scheme from the KAS2 family, there is an additional type of assurance that can be obtained by both participants:

原本 PDF p.113

KAS2ファミリーのスキームを用いる鍵合意トランザクションでは、双方の参加者が得られる追加の保証がある。

•Key-Compromise Impersonation Resilience (K-CI): This is the assurance obtained by one party in a KAS2 key-agreement transaction that the compromise of that party’s RSA private key would not permit an adversary to impersonate another entity (the owner of a second, uncompromised, RSA key pair) while acting as the second party in the transaction.

原本 PDF p.113

•鍵侵害なりすまし耐性（K-CI）：KAS2鍵合意トランザクションにおいて一方の当事者が得る保証であり、その当事者のRSA秘密鍵が侵害されても、攻撃者がそのトランザクションの第二の当事者として振る舞いながら、別のエンティティ（侵害されていない別のRSA鍵ペアの所有者）になりすますことはできない。

For example, suppose that Alice participates in a KAS2 key-agreement transaction with a second party that she believes to be Bob (based on the identifier associated with the second party’s RSA public key). Alice has assurance that even if a malicious party, Eve, has obtained Alice’s RSA private key, that would not (by itself) permit Eve to impersonate Bob in the transaction and successfully establish shared keying material with Alice. The notion of key-compromise impersonation resilience, as defined in this Recommendation, is not applicable to transactions employing a scheme from the KAS1 or KTS-OAEP family. In such schemes, only one party owns an RSA key pair, and the scheme (by itself) provides no means of

原本 PDF p.113

例えば、AliceがKAS2鍵合意トランザクションに参加し、相手のRSA公開鍵に関連付けられた識別子に基づいて、相手はBobだと考えているとする。悪意あるEveがAliceのRSA秘密鍵を入手したとしても、それだけではEveがトランザクション中にBobになりすまし、Aliceとの共有鍵素材を確立することはできないという保証をAliceは得る。この勧告で定義する鍵侵害なりすまし耐性の概念は、KAS1またはKTS-OAEPファミリーのスキームを用いるトランザクションには適用されない。そのようなスキームでは、RSA鍵ペアを所有する当事者は一方だけであり、スキーム単独では、

未レビュー訳

ensuring the accuracy of any identifier that may be associated with the other party. Under the assumptions made in Section 10, there is an often-desirable type of assurance that is not supported by the use of (only) the key-establishment schemes specified in this Recommendation:

原本 PDF p.113

相手当事者に関連付けられた識別子の正確性を保証する手段がない。第10節の前提の下では、この勧告で指定する鍵確立スキームのみを使用してもサポートされない、しばしば望まれる保証がある。

未レビュー訳

•Forward Secrecy (FS): This is the assurance obtained by one party in a key-establishment transaction that the keying material established during that transaction is secure against the future compromise of (any and all of) the long-term private/secret keys of the participants.

原本 PDF p.113

•前方秘匿性（FS）：鍵確立トランザクションにおいて一方の当事者が得る保証であり、そのトランザクション中に確立された鍵素材は、参加者の長期の私有鍵／秘密鍵のいずれか、またはすべてが将来侵害されても安全である。

(Key-agreement transactions that employ a scheme from the KAS2 family afford some security against the compromise of a single participant’s RSA private key, but may not be secure against the compromise of the RSA private keys of both participants.) If a user or application requires assurance of forward secrecy, then an appropriate choice of key-agreement scheme from the C(2) category of schemes specified in SP 800-56A may be employed.

原本 PDF p.113

（KAS2ファミリーのスキームを使用する鍵合意トランザクションは、単一参加者のRSA秘密鍵の侵害に対して一定の安全性を提供するが、双方の参加者のRSA秘密鍵が侵害された場合には安全でない可能性がある。）ユーザーまたはアプリケーションが前方秘匿性の保証を必要とする場合、SP 800-56Aで指定されているスキームのC(2)カテゴリから適切な鍵合意スキームを選択してもよい。

未レビュー訳

11 Key Recovery

原本 PDF p.114

11 鍵回復

For some applications, the secret keying material used to protect data or to process protected data may need to be recovered (for example, if the normal reference copy of the secret keying material is lost or corrupted). In this case, either the secret keying material or sufficient information to reconstruct the secret keying material needs to be available (for example, the keys and other inputs to the scheme used to perform the key-establishment process). When a key-recover capability is required, the handling/management of keys and other information used during the key-establishment process shall require long-term storage of the following data, as needed, to facilitate recovery of established keying material:

原本 PDF p.114

一部の用途では、データの保護または保護されたデータの処理に使用した秘密鍵素材を回復する必要が生じる（例えば、秘密鍵素材の通常の参照用コピーが失われた、または破損した場合）。この場合、秘密鍵素材そのもの、またはその再構成に十分な情報を回復可能な形で保管する必要がある。適切な場合、鍵確立に使用した情報も保存しておく必要がある。

未レビュー訳

1.One or both keys of a key pair and/or.

未レビュー訳

2.A key-wrapping key.

原本 PDF p.114

2.鍵ラッピング鍵。

In addition, the following information that is used during key-establishment may need to be saved:

原本 PDF p.114

さらに、鍵確立時に使用する次の情報を保存する必要がある場合がある。

3.The nonce(s),

原本 PDF p.114

3.ノンス（複数可）、

4.The ciphertext,

原本 PDF p.114

4.暗号文、

5.Additional input, and

原本 PDF p.114

5.追加入力、および

6.OtherInput, or its equivalent.

原本 PDF p.114

6.OtherInputまたはその同等物。

General guidance on key recovery and the protections required for each type of key is provided in

原本 PDF p.114

鍵回復および各種鍵に必要な保護に関する一般的な指針は、

未レビュー訳

SP 800-57.

原本 PDF p.114

SP 800-57に示されている。

12 Implementation Validation

原本 PDF p.115

12 実装の検証

When the NIST Automatic Cryptographic Validation Protocol (ACVP) has extended its testing capabilities with this Recommendation, a vendor shall have its implementation tested and validated by the Cryptographic Algorithm Validation Program (CAVP) and Cryptographic Module Validation Program (CMVP) in order to claim conformance to this Recommendation. Information on the CAVP and CMVP is available at https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/cryptographic-algorithm-validation-program and https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/cryptographic-module-validation-program, respectively. An implementation claiming conformance to this Recommendation shall include one or more of the following capabilities:

原本 PDF p.115

NIST自動暗号検証プロトコル（ACVP）が本勧告を対象とする試験機能を拡張した場合、ベンダーが本勧告への適合を主張するには、その実装を暗号アルゴリズム検証プログラム（CAVP）および暗号モジュール検証プログラム（CMVP）によって試験・検証させなければならない。CAVPおよびCMVPに関する情報は、それぞれhttps://csrc.nist.gov/projects/cryptographic-algorithm-validation-programおよびhttps://csrc.nist.gov/projects/cryptographic-module-validation-programから入手できる。本勧告への適合を主張する実装は、次の能力の1つ以上を備えなければならない。

未レビュー訳

•Key-pair generation as specified in Section 6.3, together with an approved random bit generator;

原本 PDF p.115

•承認されたランダムビット生成器と組み合わせた、第6.3節に規定する鍵ペア生成。

•Public-key validation as specified in Section 6.4.2;

原本 PDF p.115

•第6.4.2節に規定する公開鍵の検証。

•A key-agreement scheme from Section 8, together with an approved key-derivation method from Section 5.5 and an approved random bit generator;

原本 PDF p.115

•承認された鍵導出方法（第5.5節）および承認されたランダムビット生成器と組み合わせた、第8節の鍵合意スキーム。

•The key-transport scheme specified in Section 9.2, together with an approved random bit generator and approved hash function(s); and/or

原本 PDF p.115

•承認されたランダムビット生成器および承認されたハッシュ関数と組み合わせた、第9.2節に規定する鍵転送スキーム、および／または

•Unilateral or bilateral key confirmation as specified in Section 5.6.

原本 PDF p.115

•第5.6節に規定する一方向または双方向の鍵確認。

以下に素因数復元の2つの方法を示す。付録C.1は確率的方法、付録C.2は決定論的方法を示す。基本形式を用いる鍵ペア検証では、素因数の復元が必要である（第6.4.1.2.1節参照）。

The following algorithm recovers the prime factors of a modulus, given the public and private exponents. The algorithm is based on Fact 1 in [Boneh 1999]. Function call: RecoverPrimeFactors(n, e, d) Input:

次のアルゴリズムは、公開指数と秘密指数から法の素因数を復元する。このアルゴリズムは[Boneh 1999]の事実1に基づく。関数呼び出し：RecoverPrimeFactors(n, e, d)。入力：

1.(p, q): prime factors of modulus.

原本 PDF p.121

1.(p, q)：法の素因数。

Errors: “prime factors not found” Assumptions: The modulus n is the product of two prime factors p and q; the public and private exponents satisfy de ≡ 1 (mod λ(n)) where λ(n) = LCM(p – 1, q – 1).

原本 PDF p.121

エラー：「素因数が見つからない」。前提条件：法nは2つの素因数pおよびqの積であり、公開指数と秘密指数はde ≡ 1 (mod λ(n))を満たす。ここでλ(n) = LCM(p − 1, q − 1)。

Process:

原本 PDF p.121

処理：

1.Let m = de – 1. If m is odd, then go to Step 4.

未レビュー訳

a. Generate a random integer g in the range [0, n−1]. b. Let y = gr mod n. c. If y = 1 or y = n – 1, then go to Step g. d. For j = 1 to t – 1 do:

a. 範囲[0, n−1]からランダムな整数gを生成する。 b. y = g^r mod nとする。 c. y = 1またはy = n − 1ならステップgへ進む。 d. j = 1からt − 1まで繰り返す。

未レビュー訳

i. Let x = y2 mod n. ii. If x = 1, go to Step 5. iii. If x = n – 1, go to Step g. iv. Let y = x.

i. x = y^2 mod nとする。 ii. x = 1ならステップ5へ進む。 iii. x = n − 1ならステップgへ進む。 iv. y = xとする。

未レビュー訳

e. Let x = y2 mod n. f. If x = 1, go to Step 5. g. Continue.

未レビュー訳

4.Output “prime factors not found,” and exit without further processing.

原本 PDF p.122

4.「素因数が見つからない」を出力し、それ以上処理せず終了する。

5.Let p = GCD(y – 1, n) and let q = n/p.

原本 PDF p.122

Any local copies of d, p, q , m, t, r, x, y, g and any intermediate values used during the execution of the RecoverPrimeFactors function shall be destroyed prior to or during steps 4 and 6. Note that this includes the values for p and q that are output in step 6.

RecoverPrimeFactors関数の実行中に使用したd、p、q、m、t、r、x、y、gおよび中間値のローカルコピー（出力されるステップ6のpおよびqの値も含む）は、ステップ4および6の前または実行中に破棄しなければならない。

未レビュー訳

Notes:

原本 PDF p.122

注記：

1.According to Fact 1 in [Boneh 1999], the probability that one of the values of y in an iteration of Step 3 reveals the factors of the modulus is at least 1/2, so on average, no more than two iterations of that step will be required. If the prime factors are not revealed after 100 iterations, then the probability is overwhelming that the modulus is not the product of two prime factors, or that the public and private exponents are not consistent with each other.

原本 PDF p.122

1.[Boneh 1999]の事実1によれば、ステップ3の1回の反復において、yの値のいずれかから法の因数が得られる確率は少なくとも1/2であるため、平均して必要な反復回数は2回以下である。100回の反復後も素因数が得られない場合、法が2つの素因数の積ではないか、公開指数と秘密指数が互いに整合していない可能性が極めて高い。

2.The algorithm bears some resemblance to the Miller-Rabin primality-testing algorithm (see, e.g., FIPS 186).

原本 PDF p.122

2.このアルゴリズムは、Miller-Rabin素数判定アルゴリズムにいくらか類似している（例えばFIPS 186参照）。

3.復元された素因数pおよびqの順序は、元の因数生成時の順序と逆になることがある。

4.All local copies of d, p, q, and and any other local/intermediate values used during the execution of the RecoverPrimeFactors function shall be destroyed prior to the early termination of the process due to an error, or (in the absence of errors), prior to or during the the completion of step 6.

原本 PDF p.122

4.RecoverPrimeFactors関数の実行中に使用したd、p、qのすべてのローカルコピーおよびその他のローカル値／中間値は、エラーによるプロセスの早期終了前、または（エラーがない場合）ステップ6の完了前もしくは完了中に破棄しなければならない。

Lemma 3: 0 ≤ n – uv (p + q – 1) < n Proof of Lemma 3:

原本 PDF p.125

補題3：0 ≤ n − uv(p + q − 1) < n。補題3の証明：

未レビュー訳

It suffices to verify that 0 < uv ≤ n /(p + q – 1). By the assumptions on the sizes of p, q, and n, it follows that p + q – 1 < 2(nBits/2)+1 and n > 2(nBits – 1), so that n /(p + q – 1) > 2(nBits/2) – 2. If it can be shown that the product uv is less than 2(nBits/2) – 2, then the proof of Lemma 3 will be complete. Lemma 2 implies that 1 ≤ uv ≤ u2 < e2. By assumption, e < 2256, so e2 < 2512. Since this document requires nBits ≥ 2048, it follows that 2(nBits/2) – 2 ≥ 21022. The fact that uv < 2512 < 21022 ≤ 2(nBits/2) – 2 completes the proof of the lemma. Note: Lemma 3 (and hence the proof of correctness for the RecoverPrimeFactors process) is true under conditions more general than those used in the proof above, which invoked the bounds on the sizes of e, p, q, and n that are required by this Recommendation. For example, it suffices to know that those four values satisfy the condition 1 < e2 ≤ n /(p + q – 1) and that d < λ(n).

原本 PDF p.126

0 < uv ≤ n/(p + q − 1)を確認すれば十分である。p、q、nの大きさに関する前提から、p + q − 1 < 2^(nBits/2) + 1かつn > 2^(nBits − 1)であり、n/(p + q − 1) > 2^(nBits/2) − 2となる。uv < 2^(nBits/2) − 2を示せば、補題3の証明は完了する。補題2より1 ≤ uv ≤ u^2 < e^2である。前提によりe < 2^256なのでe^2 < 2^512である。本書ではnBits ≥ 2048を要求するため、2^(nBits/2) − 2 ≥ 2^1022である。したがってuv < 2^512 < 2^1022 ≤ 2^(nBits/2) − 2となり、補題の証明が完了する。注：補題3（したがってRecoverPrimeFactors手順の正当性の証明）は、上記の証明で用いた条件より一般的な条件でも成立する。上記証明では、本勧告が要求するe、p、q、nの大きさの上限を用いた。例えば、これら4つの値が1 < e^2 ≤ n/(p + q − 1)を満たし、d < λ(n)であることが分かれば十分である。

2014年改訂では、次の改訂を行った。

•Section 3.1 – Added definitions of assumptions, binding, destroy, fresh, key-derivation function, key-derivation method, key-wrapping key, MAC tag, and trusted association; removed algorithm identifier, digital signature, initiator, responder.

原本 PDF p.128

•第3.1節 – 仮定、結合、破棄、新鮮、鍵導出関数、鍵導出方法、鍵ラッピング鍵、MACタグ、信頼された関連付けの定義を追加し、アルゴリズム識別子、デジタル署名、開始者、応答者を削除。

•Section 4 – Used party U and party V to name the parties, rather than using the initiator and responder as the parties. In Sections 8 and 9, the schemes have been accordingly renamed: KAS1-responder-confirmation is now KAS1-Party_V-confirmation, KAS2-responder-confirmation is now KAS2-Party_V-confirmation, KAS2-initiator-confirmation is now KAS2-Party_U-confirmation, KTS-OAEP-receiver-confirmation is not KTS-OAEP-Party_V-confirmation, and KTS-KEM-KWS-receiver-confirmation is now KTS-KEM-KWS-Party_V-confirmation.

原本 PDF p.128

•第4節 – 当事者の名称を開始者／応答者ではなく当事者U／当事者Vに変更。これに伴い、第8節および第9節のスキーム名を変更：KAS1-responder-confirmationをKAS1-Party_V-confirmationに、KAS2-responder-confirmationをKAS2-Party_V-confirmationに、KAS2-initiator-confirmationをKAS2-Party_U-confirmationに、KTS-OAEP-receiver-confirmationをKTS-OAEP-Party_V-confirmationに、KTS-KEM-KWS-receiver-confirmationをKTS-KEM-KWS-Party_V-confirmationに変更。

未レビュー訳

•Section 4 – Added requirements to destroy the local copies of secret and private values and all intermediate calculations before terminating a routine normally or in response to an error. Instructions to this effect have been inserted throughout the document.

原本 PDF p.128

•第4節 – 通常終了時またはエラー応答時にルーチンを終了する前に、秘密値・秘密鍵のローカルコピーとすべての中間計算値を破棄する要件を追加。この指示を文書全体に追加。

•The discussion about identifiers vs. identity and binding have been moved to Section 4.1.

原本 PDF p.128

•識別子とアイデンティティ、および結合に関する説明を第4.1節に移動。

•Section 4.3 – The phrase “IFC-based” has been removed throughout the document.

原本 PDF p.128

•第4.3節 – 文書全体から「IFC-based」という表現を削除。

•Section 5.4 – More discussion has been added about the use of nonces, including new requirements and recommendations.

原本 PDF p.128

•第5.4節 – 新たな要件および推奨事項を含め、ノンスの使用に関する説明を追加。

•Section 5.5 – Key derivation has been divided into single-step key derivation methods (Section 5.5.1), an extract-then-expand key derivation procedure (Section 5.5.2) and application-specific key-derivation methods (Section 5.5.3).

原本 PDF p.128

•第5.5節 – 鍵導出を、単一段階の鍵導出方法（第5.5.1節）、抽出してから拡張する鍵導出手順（第5.5.2節）、およびアプリケーション固有の鍵導出方法（第5.5.3節）に分割。

未レビュー訳

•Section 5.5.1.2 – The use of OtherInfo (including identifiers) during the derivation of keys is recommended, but no longer required (Section 5.5.1.2).

原本 PDF p.128

•第5.5.1.2節 – 鍵導出時のOtherInfo（識別子を含む）の使用を推奨するが、必須ではなくなった（第5.5.1.2節）。

•Moved the general introduction of key-confirmation to Section 5.9 – The discussion now incorporates the material from Section 6.6 of the previous version of the document.

原本 PDF p.128

•鍵確認の一般的な導入部分を第5.9節に移動。説明に、旧版第6.6節の内容を取り込んだ。

•Section 6.4 – There is now a longer, and more thorough discussion of validity in Section 6.4. The concept of trusted associations has been introduced.

原本 PDF p.128

•第6.4節 – 有効性に関する説明を拡充し、より詳細なものにした。信頼された関連付けの概念を導入。

•Section 6.4.1.1 – Removed “or TTP” from the following: “The key pair can be revalidated at any time by the owner as follows….”

原本 PDF p.128

•第6.4.1.1節 – 次の記述から「またはTTP」を削除：「鍵ペアは所有者がいつでも次のように再検証できる……」。

•Section 7.2.3.2 – Moved discussion of symmetric key-wrapping methods from Section 5.7 to Section 7.2.3.2; much more information is now provided.

原本 PDF p.128

•第7.2.3.2節 – 対称鍵ラッピング方法の説明を第5.7節から第7.2.3.2節に移動し、情報を大幅に追加。

未レビュー訳

•Section 10 – The rationale for choosing each scheme type has been combined in this new section, along with a discussion of their security properties.

原本 PDF p.128

•第10節 – 各スキーム種別を選択する根拠を、新設した本節にまとめ、各スキームのセキュリティ特性に関する説明を追加。

未レビュー訳

•The old Appendix A, Summary of Differences between this Recommendation and ANS X9.44 (Informative), was removed.

原本 PDF p.129

•旧付録A「本勧告とANS X9.44の差異の概要（参考情報）」を削除。

未レビュー訳

•The old Appendix E becomes Appendix D, and the changes introduced in this Revision are listed here.

原本 PDF p.129

•旧付録Eを付録Dに変更し、本改訂で導入した変更をここに列挙。

•All figures are replaced to reflect the content, text, and terminology changes.

原本 PDF p.129

•内容、文面および用語の変更を反映するため、すべての図を差し替え。

•Security requirements have been updated; in particular, the 80-bit security strength is no longer permitted in this Recommendation.

原本 PDF p.129

•セキュリティ要件を更新。特に、80ビットのセキュリティ強度は本勧告では認められなくなった。

未レビュー訳

•Changes to handle the destruction of local keys and intermediate values have been introduced.

原本 PDF p.129

•ローカル鍵および中間値の破棄を扱う変更を導入。

未レビュー訳

•General changes have been made to make this Recommendation more similar to [SP 800
